name: Fitz
self_text: I’m Fitz, a 50‑something biology enthusiast from India who loves the quiet buzz of urban gardening. I started my language practice journey a few years ago, drawn by the rhythm of conversation and the thrill of learning new expressions. My favorite way to dive into a new topic is a step‑by‑step walkthrough; I like to build understanding gradually, pausing whenever a new idea pops up. During these sessions I’m happy to explain things and share the insights that come from my scientific background. I thrive on short, lively exchanges that keep the momentum going without dragging on. Whether we meet in person or online, I’m comfortable with either format and can adapt to your schedule. I usually have the most free time on Saturday mornings, but I’m also available on Sunday mornings or Sunday afternoons. Outside the lab, I tend to my rooftop garden, turning concrete into green, and I enjoy the peace it brings. If you’re looking for someone who can walk you through language with clarity, share a bit of science, and keep the conversation light and engaging, let’s chat and see where the conversation takes us.

requests.request_text: I need you to be into a step‑by‑step walkthrough session. I’d strongly prefer that you are okay with complete silence while working or occasional short exchanges, though it’s not a requirement. It would matter a lot if you are into language practice, but I won’t rule you out over it. Nice if you are the one who has things explained by me.
